## MeshPilot 0.13.0

MeshPilot is an independent Android client for MeshCentral servers.

- **Reach every desktop edge:** Fit, panning and pointer following now account for the session controls and keyboard. The four corners stay reachable with the controls visible in portrait and landscape.
- **Keep your place:** opening the keyboard or changing the available screen area preserves the working point. Zoom buttons keep the visible centre instead of resetting the view.
- **Recover the view:** Fit remains available after panning at 100%, and local controls do not send accidental clicks to the remote computer.
- **Development on GitHub:** source changes, pull requests, issues and release checks now live together here. Reconstructed historical issues are explicitly labelled; outstanding device checks stay open.

Application identity and signing certificate are unchanged. This remains a prerelease; physical-phone and Windows acceptance are tracked separately.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/papajon123/meshpilot-android/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) and [known limitations](https://github.com/papajon123/meshpilot-android/blob/main/docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).
